main_measure.name: forecast-weighted 20-bar excess return per non-overlapping block, before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 and t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 and t <= -2; else inconclusive; inconclusive if fewer than 50 blocks with a non-zero position

supporting_check.name: share of forecast>0 bars whose next 20-bar return beats 20 x pooled mean daily return, vs 50%

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2 (or is undefined), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Allocation is postRebalance_current_allocation, blocks are bars at positions 0-19, 20-39, ... of each window with bars lacking a 20-bar forward return left out, the t uses all such blocks (zero-position ones included) while the minimum counts blocks holding any non-zero position, and the supporting check passes when the share exceeds 50% over all (overlapping) forecast>0 bars.
